change: Increase the official-origin range size from 1 MiB to 32 MiB while retaining the same resume offset, byte budget, object identities, candidate set, and analysis rules.
reason: The official origin took about 90 seconds to prepare a valid 1 MiB response, then returned the exact requested bytes. The latency is per request rather than proportional to body size; four 32 MiB-or-smaller ranges reduce repeated origin preparation without increasing the accepted object or scientific scope.
integrity: Every response must still be HTTP 206 with an exact Content-Range. The completed 159,164,372-byte object must match the official full SHA-256 and central-directory SHA-256 before any member inflation.
notChanged: L0001 target and L0002-L0025 candidate roles
all fingerprints, gates, ranking rules, and two independent implementations
prohibition on image acquisition and natural-position inference
scientificEffect: None; no member was inflated and no CSV row or outcome-bearing candidate metric was inspected before sealing this transport amendment.
